name: Month Ahead
description: A wall calendar for a whole panel: today up close (date, weather, plans, bin night) beside the next five weeks as tiles, each event edged in its calendar's colour. Five looks, portrait or landscape, muted colour or black and white.

choices.label: Noir: a dark today panel, soft tiles

cell_options.name: colour
cell_options.label: Colour
cell_options.help: Muted colour dithers soft rust, slate, ochre and sage tones, and edges every event in its calendar's colour. Black and white suits greyscale panels.

cell_options.name: sidebar
cell_options.label: Today panel
cell_options.help: The big date, today's weather and the day's plans, beside the grid (above it on a portrait panel). Off gives the grid the whole cell and puts each day's weather in the corner of its tile.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Weather for
cell_options.help: Search a city, or paste a 'lat, lon' pair. Blank uses the app's own location; with neither, the calendar shows without weather.

cell_options.name: feeds_filter
cell_options.label: Calendars
cell_options.help: Feed IDs, separated by commas. Blank shows every enabled calendar from Calendar Feeds.

cell_options.name: weeks
cell_options.label: Weeks shown
cell_options.help: Starts at the week holding today and rolls forward.

cell_options.name: max_events_per_day
cell_options.label: Events per day
cell_options.help: More than this shows as '+N more'.

cell_options.name: bin_day
cell_options.label: Bin night
cell_options.help: Puts a bin on that day's tile, and a 'Bins out tonight' card in the today panel when it comes round.

cell_options.name: recycling
cell_options.label: Recycling
cell_options.help: Only used when a bin night is set.

cell_options.name: recycling_from
cell_options.label: A recycling night
cell_options.help: Any date recycling went out (2026-11-04), so the widget knows which fortnight. Blank counts from the first bin night shown.
